title: Benchmark dataset of memes with text transcriptions for automatic detection of multi-modal misogynistic content
reasoning: The paper's primary subject is the creation of a benchmark dataset for the detection of misogyny, a specific form of unethical behavior and gender-based discrimination. The core of the dataset consists of labels derived from human subjects making ethical judgments about whether content is misogynistic. Thus, the work is centered on evaluating content along an ethical axis.
